messages:
Alyssa: Heads up — during the load test this morning we saw a cluster of SSE clients get 408 timeouts, then immediate reconnects. Console shows a big spike in resume retries and duplicate billing entries. Anyone seen this pattern?
Sam: saw some alerts. can you paste a sample log line?
Alyssa: sure — here's one from the proxy: `WARN proxy: session 0x7f3 resume failed status=408 retry=0 route=low-latency-shard` then immediately: `INFO proxy: reconnect session 0x7f3 resume=1 route=alt-shard`. billing logs show two token-usage records for the same client window.
Miguel: I ran into a similar thing last week during the canary. suspecting a race between the sticky-lease reassign and the resume-idempotency check. when lease flips, KV cache miss -> resume falls back to full replay.
Rachel: if resume isn't idempotent we will double-charge on replay. we should either mark resume ops with an idempotency key or gate billing until resume confirms KV hit.
Tina: also noticed routing decision tree picks 'prefer_low_latency' which aggressively swaps routes on lag. when a route swap happens mid-resume the session appears as two distinct attempts in the console (different route tags), so the UI aggregates them separately and the billing pipeline treats them as two sessions.
Josh: simple mitigation first: add jitter to the reconnect backoff and increase base backoff so we don't hammer during transient 408s. add a tiny window to delay route-swap while a resume is in-flight.
Sam: agree on jitter. current reconnect config is pretty aggressive:
```
routing:
  policy: prefer_low_latency
  reconnect:
    backoff_base_ms: 50
    max_attempts: 8
```
We should try base=150 and jitter_pct=0.25.
Miguel: longer-term we need resume idempotency. propose attaching resume_token_id that's stored in KV and checked atomically. if a resume_token_id already applied, don't replay or bill.
Rachel: +1 to resume_token_id. also console UX needs a single 'session lineage' view, not per-route shards. otherwise ops can't tell it's the same user reconciling.
Alyssa: action items I'm capturing: 1) Josh to prod a config change (backoff + jitter) as quick mitigation, 2) Miguel/Rachel to design resume_token_id and billing gating, 3) Tina to add a console aggregation that maps route-tags -> canonical session id for visibility.
Josh: I'll open a tiny canary PR and deploy to staging. will tag @Sam for logs. deploy-bot: starting rollout of config change to staging (canary=10%)
deploy-bot: rollout started: deploy/stream-proxy v2.14.3 -> staging (canary 10%)
Sam: testing now — running burst script. will report if duplicate billing still shows.
Alyssa: thanks. please add a metric: `resume_retries_per_session` and `resume_duplicate_billing_count` so we can chart and alert if it regresses.
Miguel: noted. I'll add the metric and a tracing tag for resume_token_id to the trace spans.
Rachel: once we have idempotency and the metrics, we can roll convo to prod with a safer rollback plan. :thumbsup:
Alyssa: cool. I'll file a follow-up RFC for resume idempotency design and include the console mockups.
Josh: ack.
Sam: first run looks cleaner with jitter. will validate billing pipeline tomorrow.
Alyssa: great, keep updates in this thread. thanks everyone!
